resources.string: Keeps the consoles you play on fast internal storage and moves the others to the SD card
Off. Turn on to keep internal storage for the consoles you play
Whole consoles move, never single games

Dogmatix+ and frontends such as ES-DE give each console one folder, so a console moves with its whole folder. Consoles with a favourite, a game played recently or a new download stay on internal storage; the others go to the SD card and come back when you play them again. Needs ES-DE\'s play data. ES-DE follows by itself when it is set up in Dogmatix+ and reads its systems from the download folder (restart ES-DE afterwards). Otherwise, and in Daijishō, Pegasus or RetroArch playlists, point a moved console to its new folder.
